t: Al mi mezammenin veal mi enan mezammenin
s: Al mi mezammenin veal mi enan mezammenin, ubo y"a seipim: hashshammash sheakal kezayit mezammenim alayv, sheap shello qaba atzmo bashshulchan immahem ella omed umeshammesh alehem veakal meummad, vegam holek uba beemtza akilato veen lo qebiut kelal immahem — mitztarep immahem lezimmun, shekkevan shedderek akilato bekak — zo hi qebiuto, mah sheen ken beish acher, kemo shennitbaer besiman qtz"g:
Kuti bazzeman hazzeh eno mitztarep lezimmun apillu hu chaber, shekkebar nimnu alehem vaasaum kenokrim gemurim lekol dibrehem (abal tzedoqi mezammenin alayv im chaber hu):

Am haaretz en mezammenim alayv. Vaapillu qara veshana, velo shimmesh talmide chakamim lehaqshot veliproq lehabin mittokam taame hammishnayot al buryam — hare zeh am haaretz leinyan zeh. Veakshav mezammenim apillu al am haaretz gamur, kede shello yehe kol echad holek uboneh bama leatzmo, sheim hayu poreshim mehem — gam hem hayu poreshim min hatztzibbur legamre. Umikkol maqom, mi sheeno qore qeriat shema shacharit vearbit — en mezammenim alayv, shekkevan sherob amme haaretz qoreim — lo shayyak lomar sheyyehe kol echad holek uboneh bama leatzmo im yipreshu michidim sheenam qoreim. Veen tzarik lomar mi shehu rasha veober abera beparhesya, sheeno meulleh meam haaretz bizman hattalmud (veeno domeh lakkutim qodem sheggazeru alehem, shehem hayu medaqdeqim bemitzvot shehecheziqu bahem, ubemitzvot shello hecheziqu enan moredim uposheim, ella maaseh abotehem bidehem):

Nokri en mezammenin alayv, apillu nitkavven lebarek elohenu. Vaapillu ger shemmal velo tabal en mezammenin alayv, sheeno ger ad sheyyimmol veyitbol karauy. Veger gamur yakol lebarek apillu bezimmun lehotzi acherim yede chobatam, veyakol lomar "al shehinchalta laabotenu", lepi shelleabraham nittena haaretz lemorasha, veabraham niqra "ab hamon goyim":
Onen bechol shehu patur millebarek — en mezammenin alayv. Vaapillu lehaomerim sheim ratza lehachamir al atzmo laanot ulebarek hareshut beyado, mikkol maqom, kevan shehu patur eno mitztarep:

Nashim haokelot im shelosha anashim shechayyabim lezammen — chayyabot gam hem lezammen immahem. Veim hem shalosh veratzu lechaleq lezammen leatzman — hareshut beyadam (im haanashim hem pachot measara, sheenam mezammenim beshem. Veim tzerikot lehabin leshon haqqodesh, nitbaer besiman qtz"g). Abal nashim haokelot bipne atzman peturot lezammen, veim ratzu lezammen — hareshut beyadam. Vehu haddin laabadim. Velo tehe chabura shel nashim vaabadim mezammenim yachad, mishshum peritzut haabadim, ella nashim leatzman vaabadim leatzman, ubilbad shello yezammenu beshem:

Veken im tisha anashim bene chorin veishsha achat o ebed akelu yachad — enan mitztorpin lehashlim laasara lezammen beshem, ap al pi shehem chayyabim bezimmun, shekkol dabar shebbiqdushsha eno ella baasara anashim bene chorin, kemo shennitbaer besiman n"h. Veen tzarik lomar sheenan mitztorpin lehashlim lezimmun bishlosha, kevan sheen alehem chobat zimmun kelal, ella im ken akelu im anashim shechayyabim lezammen leatzman. Vaapillu im ratzu letzorpan enam rashshaim, mippene shennireh kipritzut keshennikkar tzerup nashim im anashim bezimmun, sheomer hambarek "nebarek" betzerup kullanu. Vaapillu beishsha im balah ubenah — en chebratan naa keshemmitztorpin yachad. Veken baabadim shetztzerupan nikkar — yesh bazeh mishshum peritzut, shehaabadim hem shetupe zimma uperutzim beyoter, veen libne chorin letzorpam immahem tzerup hannireh venikkar keshemmezammenin alehem. Mah sheen ken kesheyyesh zimmun belo nashim vaabadim, ap shehannashim vehaabadim mitztorpin latzet yede chobatan bishmia mehambarek velaanot acharayv bebirkat hazzimmun — en bazeh mishshum peritzut, kevan sheen tzerupan nikkar kelal bebirkat hambarek. Ella im ken nashim vaabadim mezammenin yachad, shellazeh yesh lachosh lipritzut haabadim bannashim ap sheen tzerupan nikkar. Vehu haddin abadim im qetannim en mezammenim yachad, mishshum peritzut haabadim bemishkab zakur im haqqetannim:

Anderoginos eno mezammen lo laanashim velo lenashim, laanashim shemma hu neqeba veeno motziam yede chobatam im akelu kede sebia, kemo shennitbaer besiman qp"t, ulenashim shemma hu zakar veyesh bo mishshum peritzut. Abal mezammen hu lemino, sheim hu neqeba — kullam neqebot, veken lehippuk. Abal tumtum en mezammen apillu lemino, ki shemma kesheyyiqqara zeh yimmatze neqeba, ukesheyyiqqareu ellu yimmatzeu zekarim, veeno motziam yede chobatan:

Yesh omerim sheqqatan hayyodea lemi mebarekin mezammenin alayv, vehu sheyyaggia leonat happaotot, shehu keben t' o ben y', kol echad lepi chariputo. Ulekol happachot gadol mibben v', im hu charip veyodea meatzmo beli sheyyelammeduhu lemi mebarekin. Abal pachot mibben v' ap al pi shehu charip veyodea meatzmo — eno kelum, shehare lo higgia leonat happaotot, vahare hu kemi sheeno ben daat. Veqatan achar shehiggia leonat happaotot mitztarep apillu lezammen baasara beshem, ap lehaomerim sheeno mitztarep leqaddish ul"bareku" veliqdushsha, shebbebirkat hammazon heqellu bah, hoil vekol echad veechad yakol liptor atzmo mechiyyub birkat hazzimmun (sheyyakol lebarek leatzmo), mah sheen ken beqaddish u"bareku" uqedushsha, shekkol echad veechad lo haya yakol liptor atzmo mechiyyubo beshum inyan — tzarik sheyyihyu kullam bene mitzva. Abal b' qetannim enan mitztorpin. Abal yesh omerim shebben lishlosha ben laasara en haqqatan mitztarep ad sheyyihyeh ben y"g shana shelemot, sheaz ap al pi shehu qatan poreach, dehaynu shepparechu bo b' searot velo nigmeru beshiuran, shehu kede lakop roshan leiqqaran — heqellu bo letzorpan lezimmun ben lishlosha ben laasara, ap al pi shellekol hammitzvot hu qatan, vehu sheyyodea lemi mebarekim. Abal im nigmeru simanayv keshiuran — en medaqdeqin acharayv im yodea lemi mebarekin, umezammenin alayv bekol inyan, kevan shehiggia liklal mitzvot. Veyesh machamirin veomerim sheapillu hu ben y"g shelemot veyodea lemi mebarekin, im yadua shello hebi b' searot arukkot keshiuran — en letzorpo lo lishlosha velo laasara. Abal bistam mezammenin alayv, shezzimmun hu middibre soperim, vesomekin al hachazaqa shemmin hassetam hebi b' searot keshiuran betashlum y"g shana kederek rob bene adam. Veken nohagin bimdinot ellu shello lezammen al qatan pachot mibben y"g veyom echad, veen leshannot. Vekol zeh leinyan zimmun, abal lehotzi acherim yede chobatam bebirkato — ledibre hakkol eno motzi ad sheyyihyeh ben y"g shana veyom echad veyadua shehebi b' searot keshiuran al yede bediqa, o shennitmalle zeqano, shebbirkat hammazon hu min hattora, ubeshel tora en somekin al chazaqa zo:

Mi shebbene adam machaziqin oto leshoteh, im lo higgia liklal shoteh sheddibberu bo chakamim — mezammenin alayv. Abal cheresh veshoteh sheddibberu bahem chakamim bekol maqom sheenan bene daat upeturim mikkol hammitzvot — dinam keqatan pachot mibben v', sheen mezammenin alayv ledibre hakkol, veen mitztorpin lo lishlosha velo laasara. Vecheresh sheddibberu bo chakamim bekol maqom hu sheeno shomea velo medabber, abal medabber veeno shomea (veken illem sheeno medabber veshomea) (apillu hem shenayim veyoter), kevan shehem kepiqchim lekol dibrehem — mitztorpim lezimmun, im hem mebinim umekavvenin lazeh (ap al pi sheen hacheresh shomea birkat hazzimmun vehaillem eno oneh). Bammeh debarim amurim? Lezimmun baasara, shelledabar shebbiqdushsha en aniyyat hammiut meakkabtam, kemo shennitbaer besiman n"h, abal lezimmun bishlosha tzarik shehashshenayim yishmeu mippi hammezammen ad siyyum birkat "hazzan", vegam sheyyaanu acharayv: "baruk sheakalnu ku'", veim lav — en kan zimmun kelal, kemo shennitbaer besiman qtz"g:

Mi shennidduhu al debar abera en metzorpin oto lezimmun, lo lishlosha velo laasara, shezzehu inyan nidduy, shemmarchiqim oto umabdilim oto meaguddatam. Veim nidduhu al isqe mamon, yitbaer beyoreh dea siman shl"d:
